key_insight: A first-principles spin-vibronic model reproduces the hidden quadrupolar and canted magnetic phases of Ba₂MgReO₆, supporting cooperative ordering of spin–orbit–lattice entangled states.
engineering_relevance: This work informs predictive modeling of coupled electronic and structural order in quantum materials, rather than AI or solar-cell engineering.
method: Derive a spin-vibronic Hamiltonian from first principles.
Use the vibronic states previously established through RIXS spectra.
Adjust one elastic-coupling scale factor to match the quadrupolar transition temperature.
evidence_signal: With the quadrupolar transition calibrated to 34.7 K versus 33 K measured, the model predicts a magnetic transition at 19.3 K versus 18 K measured and reproduces antiferro distortion and ferro elongation between transitions.
watch_item: The elastic-coupling scale factor is fitted, and applicability beyond Ba₂MgReO₆ remains to be established.
